name: Arholma
description: Northern start of the Stockholm Archipelago Trail, looping from Arholma quay through hamlets, gravel roads, forest paths and a more technical eastern coastal section with views over the Aland Sea. The route has good island services for a small archipelago section, but many are seasonal and water reliability should be checked before relying on it.
utilities: Arholma ferry quay has the key arrival cluster: Arholma Handel, Bryggcafet in season, nearby toilets and the start/end of the loop.
Arholma Handel is the main resupply point and is described as year-round, but low-season opening hours are limited.
Arholma Nord and Bull-August provide lodging and food/service options with seasonal or booking-dependent availability.
Dry toilets are reported at the campsite, Ahlmansviken/guest-harbor area, Osterhamn and Arholma Nord; winter availability is limited.
No overnight wind shelter was confirmed in the first research cycle.
waterSources: Carry enough water for the full 13.4 km unless current potable water access has been confirmed.
Official SAT guidance says water is available at Österhamn guest harbor/pump but not in winter.

Osterhamn pump is the best confirmed drinking-water point in season: mapped around 59.845399, 19.121137, about 100 m from the guest harbor rather than on the pontoon, but official SAT says it is not available in winter.
Ahlmansviken/campsite pump needs caution: community/OSM/Wikimedia notes report uncertain potable status, high iron or untested/brown water.
No reliable public winter water source was confirmed; winter plans should rely on carried water, ferry toilets, purchases during shop hours, or customer/guest access at open businesses.
notes: Route shape: loop from Arholma ferry quay, recommended clockwise.
Trail is marked with blue/yellow/reflection SAT markings and official guidance recommends clockwise travel.
Eastern coastal part is more technical, with rock/root terrain; forest road can be wet in spring or after rain.
Recent community reports in 2025 mostly describe good conditions and easy navigation, with one muddy/obstruction report.
Dogs must be leashed in the nature reserve; this is stricter than the general SAT March-September guidance.
From April 1 to July 31, landing on Röd-/Nollekobben bird-protection islets or entering water within 100 m is prohibited; these are not on the main loop but are inside the same reserve.
Ticks/TBE are a general archipelago/Stockholm coastal concern from spring through autumn; late-July algal blooms can affect swimming.
Pack out trash; island waste handling is limited.

facilities.name: Arholma brygga
facilities.description: Main ferry quay and trail start/end near Arholma Handel.

facilities.name: Arholma Handel
facilities.description: Main grocery/resupply point near the ferry quay; year-round but low-season hours are limited.

facilities.name: Bryggcafet
facilities.description: Seasonal quay cafe/kiosk associated with Arholma Handel; current source says it returns summer 2026.

facilities.name: Arholma Dansbana
facilities.description: Summer restaurant/cafe by the dance pavilion near the quay; seasonal opening.

facilities.name: Arholma/dansbana public toilets
facilities.description: Mapped public toilets near the quay/dance pavilion area.

facilities.name: Arholma tältplats
facilities.description: Designated small/basic tent site by Ahlmansviken just north of the ferry quay. OSM lists capacity 10 tents and fee=no; no official booking page was found, so treat as first-come and self-sufficient.

facilities.name: Arholma campsite toilets
facilities.description: Dry/public toilets at or by the campsite; not winter-reliable.

facilities.name: Ahlmansviken/campsite pump
facilities.description: Mapped pump near Ahlmansviken/campsite; OSM/community note reports high iron/not tested and some users avoid it. Verify locally before drinking.

facilities.name: Ahlmansviken guest harbour toilets
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near Ahlmansviken guest harbor.

facilities.name: Ahlmansviken beach
facilities.description: Beach/swimming area at Ahlmansviken, described as sandy/rocky by local sources.

facilities.name: Osterhamn pump
facilities.description: Seasonal drinking-water pump about 100 m from Osterhamn guest harbor, not on the pontoon. OSM/Wikimedia and harbor guides support potable/fresh water; official SAT says guest-harbor water is not available in winter.

facilities.name: Osterhamn toilet
facilities.description: Dry/public toilet at or near Osterhamn/east harbor; not winter-reliable.

facilities.name: Osterhamns pensionat
facilities.description: B&B/hostel/cafe near Osterhamn; lodging may be year-round, cafe is seasonal and should be checked.

facilities.name: Bull-August gård / STF Arholma
facilities.description: Hostel/lodging and guest-dependent service point passed by the route option. Do not treat as a public food stop; toilets, water, kitchen and barbecue are customer/guest-dependent.

facilities.name: Bull-August barbecue
facilities.description: Mapped customer barbecue near Bull-August; treat as private/customer use unless confirmed.

facilities.name: Arholma Nord
facilities.description: Lodging/restaurant/service area near the northern part of the route, with seasonal food and activities including Batteri Arholma.

facilities.name: Arholma Nord public toilet
facilities.description: Mapped public toilet at Arholma Nord.

facilities.name: Arholma Nord grill place
facilities.description: Mapped grill place near Arholma Nord. It was not confirmed as an official public reserve fireplace; treat as venue-controlled unless Arholma Nord confirms use. Fires must respect reserve rules and fire bans.

facilities.name: East coast swimming point
facilities.description: Mapped east-coast swimming point along/near the more technical coastal part of the trail.

facilities.name: East coast beach/cove
facilities.description: Mapped east-coast beach/cove along/near the coastal part of the route.

facilities.name: Granö brygga
facilities.description: Summer/alternative dock mentioned by official SAT route guidance.

facilities.name: Simpnäs brygga
facilities.description: Main mainland bus/ferry transfer for the year-round Simpnäs-Arholma passenger boat. Some timetable-marked departures require advance booking/request.
